title: Fetor judaicus
html_source:
fetor judaicus (Latin) Jewish stench. It is said that the myth that Jews emit a fetid stink derives from an error (possibly deliberate) of a medieval copyist, who mistranscribed a passage by Ammianus Marcellinus, replacing Judaeorum petentium (of the attacking Jews) with Judaeorum fetentium (of the ill-smelling Jews).
en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Annotations to James Joyce’s Ulysses.

Bloom is and isn’t a Jew in Ulysses. In third person, he is Jewish. In first, he never states he is Jewish. It is a parallel to the character of Molly about whom we only hear third person accounts for the most part of the ‘novel’!
